# Stone: the lead singer's seat, a 9-sided boulder 1.3 m across, its mossy top 0.33 m above the
# water. Origin at the water line. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.2863 0.3216 0.4000 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.1804 0.2510 0.2392 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Stone --vertices 9 --radius 0.66 --depth 0.55 --location 0 0 0.06
apply --location
material assign Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select vert where "pos.z > 0.3"
scale 0.82 0.82 1
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Moss
select vert where "pos.z > -0.1"
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 9
mode object
shade flat
export stone.glb
